name: Tortilla de Papas
instructions: Peel and slice the potatoes thinly.
Finely chop the onion.
Heat olive oil in a pan and fry the potatoes and onions until soft.
Beat the eggs with salt in a bowl.
Drain excess oil and mix potatoes and onions with the eggs.
Pour back into the pan and cook on low heat until set, flipping once to cook both sides.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese (Vegetarian)
instructions: Cook lentils according to package instructions.
Finely chop the carrot, onion, and garlic.
Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté garlic and onion until translucent.
Add carrot and cook for a few minutes.
Add tomato paste, cooked lentils, salt, and basil. Simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
Combine the sauce with spaghetti and serve hot.

name: Matar Paneer
instructions: Chop onions, tomatoes, garlic, and ginger.
Heat oil in a pan, add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add garlic and ginger, sauté for a minute, then add onions and cook until golden.
Add tomatoes, turmeric, salt, and cook until soft.
Add green peas and cook for 5 minutes.
Add paneer cubes, garam masala, and a splash of water if needed. Simmer for 5-7 minutes.
Serve hot with rice or roti.
